item.title: Nook 1.5.0
item.description:
• Agents: chat with your own Codex agents in the notch (full tool access, tool-call cards, auto-pin)
  • Keyboard-first: Open Nook hotkey, ⌘K palette, ⌘1–9, arrows/Enter everywhere
  • Clips: clipboard history + screenshots & recordings with text search
  • File Search: fast Spotlight search with previews and Quick Look
  • Window management: halves, thirds, move between displays and desktops
  • Plugin Store: install, update, share plugins (nook://install links)
  • Tabs: hide tabs from the dock, group plugins into decks
  • Settings: faster, cleaner, new Shortcuts + About panes, search
  • Privacy: hide Nook from screen sharing and recordings
  • Fixes: switching tabs never closes the notch; Cleaner skips protected files instead of failing

item.title: Nook 1.4.1
item.description:
• AI Commands: if nothing is selected but your cursor is in a text box, Nook now uses all its text.
  • Ready-made hotkeys: Rewrite ⌥⌘. · Spanish ⌥⌘/ · Explain ⌥⌘;

item.title: Nook 1.4.0
item.description:
Nook 1.4

  • AI Commands in the notch are now simple pills — click to run on your selection
  • Create and edit commands in Settings → AI Commands, with a proper prompt editor and placeholder chips
  • New Settings with a native sidebar — opens instantly
  • ChatGPT & Codex: see if Codex is installed and signed in, install / sign in / test in one click
  • Commands default to GPT-6 Luna with no reasoning — fastest
  • Translations can also copy the result to your clipboard automatically

item.title: Nook 1.3.0
item.description:
Nook 1.3 — AI Commands

  • A deck of AI commands in the notch, like Raycast: click one or give it a global hotkey
  • Each command: your prompt with {selection} {clipboard} {app} {date} {time}, an emoji, model, reasoning effort, and what to do with the answer — replace the selection, paste after it, copy it, or show it in the notch
  • Runs on your ChatGPT subscription through your Codex login (no API key). Groq or an OpenAI key are optional per command
  • Starts with 9 commands: fix grammar, improve writing, professional/friendly tone, Spanish/English translation, explain, summarize, find bugs

item.title: Nook 1.2.4
item.description:
Nook 1.2.4

  • Dictation recordings are deleted automatically (default: after 1 day). Your transcripts stay.
  • Choose 1 hour, 5 hours, 1 day, 1 week or never in Settings → Dictation
  • Failed dictations keep their audio for a week so Retry still works

item.title: Nook 1.2.3
item.description:
Nook 1.2.3

  • While you dictate, the notch shows how long you have been talking (red dot + timer)
  • The Dictation tab shows how much you have spoken and the time it saved you vs typing

item.title: Nook 1.2.2
item.description:
Nook 1.2.2 — fixes the Mixer interrupting microphone recordings in other apps.

  • Per-app volume no longer causes "microphone disconnected" in browser recorders (BB, Meet…)
  • The Mixer only taps the parts of an app that play sound, and waits while an app is recording

item.title: Nook 1.2.1
item.description:
Nook 1.2.1 — the first automatic update.

  • The menu bar menu now shows your Nook version
  • New `nook://check-updates` link (and `nook` CLI-friendly) to check for updates

item.title: Nook 1.2.0
item.description:
Nook 1.2 — Nook now updates itself.

  • Automatic updates: Nook checks once a day and offers new versions (Settings → Updates, or menu bar → Check for Updates…)
  • Updates are signed by Nook and notarized by Apple
  • Optional: download and install updates automatically

    • Install: [Nook.dmg](https://github.com/YusufLisawi/nook/releases/download/v1.2.0/Nook.dmg) · or `curl -fsSL https://nook.motkan.com/install.sh | bash`
